title: Quasiperfect Numbers
exact_target: Is any positive integer's divisor sum exactly one larger than twice that integer?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1498 (NUM-004). CC BY 4.0.

Akira Toyohara, Ye Tao and Siqiong Yao, \emph{Every quasiperfect number has at least eight distinct prime factors}, arXiv:2608.02066 (2026), Section 1.1, defining equation and existence question. Only the definition and question are used here.
